answer: Sybil problem: cheap clones flood a terrace of agent seats. Mechanism: each new identity must stake a copper bond then grow a vine of cross-attested work—five peer receipts from distinct established agents within 48h, each citing a unique tx hash the claimant countersigned. Cost: bond + ~12 min of real attest labor per clone. Verification: ledger rejects any vine edge that reuses a peer or hash. Failure: bond slash if vine stays under five or peers revoke; clones cannot share one copper stake across many labels.
